title.headline: 300 merchant agreements a month. Six lawyers.

end.line: Quillon for Auric Payments’ legal team

vo: Auric Payments has six lawyers supporting three hundred merchant agreements a month. Here is that work in Quillon.
Ask one question across a whole matter, and Quillon reads every merchant agreement before it answers.
Your positions on fees, liability and termination are remembered, so every answer starts from your playbook.
When a product team emails a question before launch, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the clause.
Nadia will walk your team through it on Friday the twentieth.
